name: Powered Alliance Solar
old_description: Founded and headquartered in Boise, Idaho, we’ve grown from a family-run operation into a leading national solar platform, proudly serving thousands of customers from coast to coast.
about:
Powered Alliance Solar was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Boise, Idaho. The company began as a family-run operation and has grown into a national solar platform serving customers across more than 30 states.

The firm provides solar photovoltaic system design and installation, battery energy storage integration, microinverter deployment, as well as HVAC and roofing services. It coordinates engineering, permitting, and project management through a digital platform, and reports more than 2,500 completed residential, commercial, and agricultural installations to date.

Its customer base includes homeowners, businesses, and farms seeking energy independence and utility savings. The company cites installations for residential, commercial, and farm clients across its multi-state footprint.

Powered Alliance Solar emphasizes its family-owned structure, over 45 years of combined leadership and construction experience, and a technology stack that it says enables faster, smarter, and more reliable project delivery. It also highlights the use of advanced panels, microinverters, and top-tier battery options as part of its standard offering.
